guide_welcome.text: Hey, I'm Erva. First time here? Come on, I'll show you around. Won't take long.

guide_start.text: This is where you start a run. It costs five energy. Pick your map first, then off you go.

guide_gear.text: Got some new gear? Bring it here and equip it. A shiny sword won't help much sitting in your bag.

guide_camp.text: Here's our camp. Food gives you more health. The stump boosts your attack, and the bench improves your defense.

guide_risk.text: Quick heads up. Training can fail. Steady is safer. Daring gives a bigger boost, but fails more often. You spend the gold either way.

guide_gift.text: Keep training, and I'll bring your milestone gifts over myself. You don't need to hunt for a claim button.

guide_shop.text: The shop's over here if you want to look around. That's the tour. Need me again? Tap Air Viz Guide. Go on, your cap is waiting.

event_intro.text: Oh, something's happening! Let's see what we've got!

event_choices.text: These are your choices. Read the little note under each one before you pick. Some help you out, others might get a little messy.

event_gold.text: This one costs gold. Check the price first, okay? I'd hate to see you spend your last coin on something you don't need.

event_risk.text: Hmm. This one's a gamble. Could turn out great. Could also hurt. Your call.

event_rest.text: A chance to rest. If your copy is looking a little rough, this might be just what you need.

event_fight.text: Feeling brave? Pick this one for a fight. Just check your health first, please.

event_chosen.text: Alright, let's see how that turns out.

event_travel.text: All done here? Tap the travel button when you're ready. I'll be right behind you.
